definitions.gloss: working holiday; working holiday visa program
definitions.explanation: A program based on bilateral agreements that lets young people stay in a partner country long-term and take short-term work to fund their travel. The full form of the abbreviation ワーホリ.

examples.japanese: ワーキングホリデー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦カナダ→カナダ：30077_kanada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to Canada on a working holiday.

examples.japanese: ワーキングホリデー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: to make use of the working holiday program.

examples.japanese: ワーキングホリデービザ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}{制限|せいげん}→年齢制限：17929_nenreiseigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{申請|しんせい}できる→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三十歳|さんじゅっさい}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧だ。
examples.english: Working holiday visas generally have an age limit, and you can only apply up to the age of thirty.

notes:
The full form of the common abbreviation ⟦ワーホリ→ワーホリ：06608_waahori⟧. Refers to a scheme that combines travel with the right to work part-time abroad.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ワーキングホリデー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go on a working holiday
- ワーキングホリデービザ: a working holiday visa
- ワーキングホリデー⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: the working holiday program

USAGE:
Usually restricted to young people (often up to age 30) from countries that have a working holiday agreement with the destination country.
